Reference / os/environment

os/environment#

Environment is an immutable snapshot.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let system = Environment();
let isolated = Environment(values: ["LANG": "C.UTF-8"]);

Description#

Environment is an immutable snapshot. Environment() reads the process environment exactly once; Environment(values: ...) is completely isolated:

Variables read like json values. An absent variable is distinct from one that holds an empty string:

let env = Environment();
env.text("HOME");                     // MissingEnvironmentVariable if absent
env.maybe("PORT").int() else 8080;    // optional, still typed
env.boolean("DEBUG");                 // true or false
env.list("PATH");                     // split at the OS separator, [] if absent
if env.membership("EDITOR") { … }

addition() and difference() build new snapshots without changing their receiver:

let child = system
    .addition("APPLICATION_ENV", "production")
    .difference("APPLICATION_TOKEN");

Names are case-sensitive on POSIX and normalized case-insensitively on Windows. Empty names, names containing = or NUL, and values containing NUL are rejected before an Environment becomes observable.

home() derives the home directory from this snapshot alone and never rereads ambient process state:

let home is Directory = Environment().home();

Environment.Environment#

Environment()

The process environment, read once now.

Environment.Environment#

Environment(values is %string:string)

Exactly these variables and nothing of the process.

Environment.membership#

membership(name is string) is bool

Whether the variable is set, even to an empty value.

Environment.text#

text(name is string) is string

The value of name: env.text("HOME"). An absent variable is MissingEnvironmentVariable.

Environment.int#

int(name is string) is int

The value of name as an integer: env.int("PORT"). A value that is not one is InvalidEnvironmentValue, naming the variable and the value.

Environment.boolean#

boolean(name is string) is bool

The value of name as true or false: env.boolean("DEBUG").

Environment.list#

list(name is string) is @string

The value of name split at the separator of the OS's path lists (":" on POSIX, ";" on Windows): env.list("PATH"). An absent or empty variable gives []; an empty part between separators stays.

Environment.maybe#

maybe(name is string) is EnvironmentMaybeValue

A variable that may be absent: env.maybe("PORT").int() else 8080.

Environment.variables#

variables() is %string:string

Every variable.

Environment.temporary#

temporary() is Directory

The home directory this environment names (HOME, or USERPROFILE on Windows), not the account database's (os/account's User().home()). The directory for temporary files: TMPDIR, then TMP and TEMP, else /tmp.

Environment.home#

home() is Directory

The home directory named by this snapshot (HOME, or USERPROFILE on Windows); MissingHomeDirectory when there is none.
